decision.title: Thriller 25
tracklist: Vincent Price Excerpt from Thriller Voice-Over Session

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (16 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thriller_25, https://www.moodomedia.com/products/michael-jackson-thriller-25-remastered-2lp-brand-new-vinyl. 25th anniversary reissue of Thriller (2008). CD: original 9 tracks + Vincent Price voice-over excerpt + 5 2008 remixes + 'For All Time'. DVD tracks excluded.
